brand-strategy.headline: We start by deciding where the brand should go.
description:
A strong brand does not begin with a logo or color.

Who it is for,
where it should sit in the market,
and how it should be remembered —
those come first.

Newon Studio Brand Strategy reviews brand, product, audience, and competition together, then sets a clear direction for everything that follows.
brand-strategy.metaDescription: Brand Strategy — define brand direction, positioning, audience, message, and tone as the baseline for Naming, Identity, and Digital. From ₩400,000 · 1–3 weeks.

overview.title:
Before shaping what people see,
set the brand baseline.
body: Brand strategy is not a short idea dump or a design task.
It defines what problem the brand solves, who needs it, how it differs from competitors, and how it should be remembered.
That strategy becomes the shared baseline for Naming, Identity, Logo, Website, App, Content — every place the brand meets people.

Define the brand’s place.

Versus competitors, which value and difference should lead how you explain the brand.

Define the brand core.

Purpose

Build what the brand should say.

Core customer message and a basic language direction.

Define how the brand should speak and appear.

A communication direction usable later on Website, App, SNS, and Campaign.

naming.headline:
A strong name is
the brand’s first asset.
description: We analyze brand strategy, product character, audience, market, and expandability — then develop names that are easy to remember and built to last.

This is not a list of random candidates.
It is designing how the brand will be remembered.
naming.metaDescription: Naming — develop memorable, lasting names from brand character, audience, market, and expandability. From ₩300,000 · 1–2 weeks.

overview.title:
Even a name
needs strategy.
body: A strong name is not just a pleasant-sounding word.
It should carry what the brand does, who it is for, the impression it should leave, and how far it can grow.
Newon Naming analyzes brand and product, defines keywords and meaning axes, explores multiple directions, and develops candidates that can become a real brand.
overview.criteriaLead: We weigh criteria like these together.

naming.problemsTitle: Naming helps in situations like these.

problems.d:
The brand is ready — the name is not.

Product and direction are set, but starting with the right name is hard.

The name is too ordinary.

It disappears in search, app stores, social, and the market.

Hard to read or remember.

Spelling or pronunciation is complex — or awkward across Korean and English.

Name and brand do not connect.

There is a name, but value and character do not come through.

The current name must change.

Direction, audience, or product shifted — the old name no longer fits.

Global expansion is on the roadmap.

You need a name that can work beyond Korea.

Define the direction and criteria the name should meet.

Deliver recommendations ranked by strategy and usability.

identity.headline:
So the brand is remembered
the same way, everywhere.
description: We turn brand strategy into a visual language people can see and feel.
Color, typography, graphic elements, imagery, and usage principles become one system — so web, app, social, and content stay consistent.

This is not decoration.
It is building visual rules the brand can keep living by.
identity.metaDescription: Identity — design color, type, graphics, imagery, and usage rules as one Visual Identity System. From ₩600,000 · 2–4 weeks.

overview.title:
A logo alone
does not finish a brand.
body: Customers do not experience a brand through one logo alone.
Website color, app screens, social content, ads, images, documents, and small graphic details repeat until one brand image forms.
Strong brands need a Visual Identity System that keeps each design connected — not drifting apart.
Newon Identity defines core visual elements from brand strategy, then builds a consistent design language and usage rules so the brand stays recognizable across contexts.

identity.problemsTitle: Identity helps in situations like these.

problems.d:
The brand looks different every time.

Website, app, social, and content use different colors and design — it does not feel like one brand.

There is a logo — but no next rules.

After the logo, color, type, imagery, and graphics were never defined.

It looks like other brands.

The product is differentiated, but visually it blends into the market.

Products and channels are growing.

Web, app, social, and ads need shared design criteria.

You want to change the brand image.

Direction or audience shifted — current design no longer expresses the brand.

Every team designs differently.

Designers, developers, and marketers produce separate looks — consistency breaks.

logo-design.headline:
Recognized at a glance.
Remembered as the brand’s face.
description: We compress brand strategy and character into their clearest visual form.
Not just a pleasant symbol — a Logo System that makes the brand identifiable and memorable.
From tiny icons to large screens, we design form, structure, proportion, and usage so the mark works across web, app, social, and more.
logo-design.metaDescription: Logo Design — design the core identifying mark and a Logo System that works in real environments. From ₩400,000 · 2–3 weeks.

overview.title:
A strong logo lets people
recognize the brand without explanation.
body: A logo is one of the most repeated visual assets where brand meets people.
It appears across websites, app icons, social profiles, products, ads, and documents — forming memory through repetition.
A strong logo is not only a distinctive shape. It should express brand character, stay memorable, work across sizes and contexts, and remain usable over time.
Newon Logo Design builds the core mark and a practical Logo System from brand strategy and Identity.

logo-design.problemsTitle: Logo Design helps in situations like these.

problems.d:
There is no logo to represent the brand.

Business and product are ready, but no core mark identifies the brand visually.

The current logo is too ordinary.

It blends with other brands or fails to make distinctive memory.

It fails when small.

Fine on large screens, but form breaks in app icons, mobile, and tiny digital use.

Logo and brand no longer match.

Business, audience, or direction moved on — the mark still looks like the past.

The logo changes every time it is used.

Color, proportion, placement, and versions are undefined.

The brand appears in more places.

App, web, social, ads, documents, and product need a Logo System.

web-design.headline:
Beyond a good-looking site.
We design experiences that move people to act.
description: We turn brand strategy and purpose into a real web touchpoint.
Information architecture, user flow, content hierarchy, responsive experience, and conversion structure are designed together — so visitors understand the brand and reach the action you want.

Not just pretty pages.
A digital experience where brand goals and user goals meet.
web-design.metaDescription: Web Design — IA, user flow, UI, responsive, and conversion structure. Design only · from ₩600,000 · 5–7 days.

overview.title:
A website is not a showcase.
It is a place that drives action.
body: Customers first understand a brand, compare products, build trust, and buy or inquire through the website.
A strong website is not a brochure page.
It must decide what to show first, in what order, where people pause, and where they act.
Newon Web Design connects information architecture, screen flow, visual hierarchy, and conversion structure to brand character and business goals — so the experience actually works.
overview.criteriaLead: CTA structure follows visit purpose. We do not emphasize every button — we separate primary and secondary actions so people do not hesitate.

web-design.problemsTitle: Web Design helps in situations like these.

problems.d:
There is a lot of information — and nowhere clear to start.

Too much content for visitors to grasp the core quickly.

People visit, but they do not act.

Inquiry, purchase, signup, or download never connects naturally.

The site no longer matches the brand.

Brand and product grew — the website stayed in the past.

Mobile feels broken.

Desktop is fine, but structure, readability, buttons, and flow fail on mobile.

It looks like every other company site.

Brand differentiation never shows up in the experience.

Services and content keep expanding.

Products, features, news, cases, and new pages need a scalable structure.

app-ui-ux.headline:
Not just screens —
flows people keep coming back to.
description: We design the full experience — from first launch through understanding core features, repeat use, and completing key actions.
Information architecture, user flows, screen priority, states, interaction, and a design system come together so complex features feel intuitive.

Not pretty screens alone —
designing how the product is actually used.
app-ui-ux.metaDescription: App UI/UX — flows, screens, states, prototype, and basic UI system. Design only · from ₩800,000 · 3–6 weeks.

overview.title:
A strong app is not the one with the most features —
it is the one where the next action feels obvious.
body: Apps connect signup, explore, input, save, pay, notify, settings — many actions in one product.
A little extra friction and people miss features or drop off mid-flow.
Strong App UI/UX is less about one perfect screen and more about how flows and product structure connect.
Newon App UI/UX analyzes product goals and user behavior, then connects feature structure, screen flow, interaction, states, and a design system into a usable, scalable product experience.
overview.criteriaLead: We design for products used with fingers. Haptics and similar cues depend on development scope and platform.

app-ui-ux.problemsTitle: App UI/UX helps in situations like these.

problems.d:
Many features — hard to use.

Too many steps to reach a goal, or unclear what to do next.

People leave mid-flow.

Signup, onboarding, input, or checkout keeps losing users.

Features exist, but product structure does not.

Screens and features pile up until IA and navigation get messy.

Design and behavior change per screen.

Buttons, inputs, cards, and modals look and act differently everywhere.

There is an idea — but not yet a product experience.

Concept and features are set; turning them into usable screens is hard.

The existing app needs redesign.

Usability issues, weak conversion, dated UI, or growth force a structural reset.

Features keep growing.

New screens break structure and design consistency.

Every build invents screens again.

No reusable UI rules — slow development and maintenance.

landing-page-design.headline:
On one page —
make it clear, then make them act.
description: We design a Landing Page focused on one product, service, campaign, or launch goal — so visitors grasp core value quickly and move to inquire, apply, buy, or download.

Not pretty sections alone —
message order, trust, CTAs, and conversion flow designed as one story.
landing-page-design.metaDescription: Landing Page — single-page design focused on one conversion goal. Design only · from ₩400,000 · 1–3 weeks.

overview.title:
A landing page is short —
so the strategy must be clearer.
body: A typical website can explain brand and services across many pages. A Landing Page must persuade inside a limited screen.
Visitors judge fit on the first screen, gather more as they scroll, then decide to act.
A strong Landing Page answers the questions below clearly.
Newon Landing Page designs content order and UI structure so the whole page works as one conversion flow.
overview.criteriaLead: These six answers should be clear before design begins.

landing-page-design.problemsTitle: Landing Page helps in situations like these.

problems.d:
You are launching a product or service.

You need one focused page before a full website.

The offer is hard to explain.

A strong product — but visitors cannot tell what it is on first view.

Traffic exists, but inquiry or purchase does not follow.

CTA placement, content order, and persuasion structure are unclear.

You need campaign focus.

Event, promo, pre-registration, early access — one goal, one page.

You need app downloads.

Explain value fast and connect to App Store / Google Play.

You need a page for ad traffic.

Ad message and landing experience must stay consistent.

You want to validate an idea quickly.

Collect waitlist, inquiry, or signup before full product build.

landing-page-design.ctaTitle:
Put the most important story
on one page.
landing-page-design.ctaLead: We design message and visuals as one conversion flow — so visitors understand value quickly, build trust, and choose the next action.

product-design.headline:
Turn an idea
into a product people can actually use.
description: We do not move feature lists straight onto screens.
We start from the user problem and the core value the product must deliver — then design prioritization, product structure, flows, interface, and a testable MVP as one experience.

Not screen production alone —
a product design process that decides what to build and how people will use it.
product-design.metaDescription: Product Design — problem definition, MVP, structure, flows, and product UI. Design only · from ₩1,200,000 · 4–8 weeks.

overview.title:
A strong product starts with a clear problem —
not with how many features it has.
body: The most common failure when building something new is packing in too many features.
Even a strong idea gets messy without clarity on what to build first, what to cut, and where users should begin.
Product Design starts before UI. We define whose problem we solve, prioritize use cases and features, then turn that into screens and flows.
Newon Product Design follows Problem → Product Structure → Core Flow → MVP → UI → Validation.

product-design.problemsTitle: Product Design helps in situations like these.

problems.d:
There is an idea — but no clear start.

Concept exists without concrete features and screens.

Too many features feel essential.

Everything looks important — MVP scope never lands.

Core value is unclear.

Long explanations, but no one-sentence reason to use it.

Feature structure is too complex.

Navigation and flows break as features keep stacking.

Build started too early.

Implementation begins before problem and core flows are clear.

You need an MVP fast.

Define the minimum scope that can prove core value before a full product.

Growth outgrew the original structure.

New features and users need a clearer product architecture.

Product, design, and engineering imagine different products.

Priority mismatch causes repeated rework.

Product goal

Prioritization

Information architecture

User flow

Wireframe

Product UI

Prototype

Connect key flows to review the product experience.

Handoff

Package product structure and design criteria for build.

useCases.d: Required to experience core value.

Can wait until after real user response.
IDEA → CORE PROBLEM → MVP SCOPE → BUILD → TEST → LEARN → ITERATE
Priority — real value to users?

campaign.headline:
One message —
delivered strongly across touchpoints.
description: Around a clear goal — launch, awareness, event, promo, or acquisition — we design campaign concept, message, creative, and digital touchpoints as one flow.

Not a single ad asset —
a campaign journey from first message contact through landing page and product experience.

overview.title:
A strong campaign leaves one clear message —
not just more exposure.
body: People do not judge a brand from a single ad alone.
They experience a campaign across social, ads, search, landing pages, websites, and product.
When each channel says something different, brand and product clarity fades.
Newon Campaign defines the core goal first, then designs Campaign Idea → Message → Creative → Channel → Landing Experience → CTA as one story.
overview.criteriaLead: What connects a campaign into one story.

campaign.problemsTitle: Campaign helps in situations like these.

problems.d:
You are launching a product or service.

Not just announcing it — you need a clear campaign message for why people should care.

Ads are shipping without one message.

Different lines and visuals per channel weaken the whole campaign.

The product is strong but hard to notice.

Feature lists alone do not earn attention or memory.

Ads and landing pages do not connect.

Message mismatch after the click causes drop-off.

You need a strong push for a set period.

Promo, event, waitlist, or seasonal communication with a deadline.

You need the brand itself to be known.

More viewpoint and impression than feature explanation.

The campaign must run across channels.

Social, landing, display, email — one campaign, consistent tone.

People do not know what to do next.

Apply, download, inquire, buy — the final action is unclear.

Strong visual content is understood before a long look —

Visually flashy content is not automatically good content.
What to show first, what to emphasize, and what to cut must be designed as information structure.
Newon Visual Content starts from brand and purpose, then designs Message → Information → Hierarchy → Visual → Application.

The product is strong but presentation is weak.

Numbers and data are hard to read.

The same message must work across channels.

experimental-ip.headline:
Make what does not exist yet —
small, fast, and testable.
description: We quickly prototype new characters, worlds, digital content, interactive ideas, and brand experiments as small builds.
Instead of locking a finished answer first, we visualize the core hypothesis, make it showable, then decide next steps from response and potential.

Not brainstorming alone —
a creative experiment that tests new IP and experience potential in real form.
experimental-ip.metaDescription: Experimental IP — custom experimental project, not a fixed package. Idea → Hypothesis → Prototype → Test → Learn. Custom quote.

overview.title:
Not every IP needs to begin
as a finished world.
body: Even with a character or content idea, it is hard to know up front whether people will care, which form fits best, or how far it can expand.
That is why small experiments come before large production.
Newon Experimental IP reviews new IP and content experiences through Idea → Hypothesis → Concept → Prototype → Test → Learn → Next.
We do not build a finished large project first — we implement the core idea in its smallest form, make a showable result, then judge expansion potential.

You need a different approach.

Review potential before moving into a new platform, format, or interactive experience.

Digital culture, AI, community, game, character, social — exploring a combined new form.
